title: al-Battani: Catalogue of the Fixed Stars, Complete Critical Dataset and Reader
version: 2026-06-04 complete fixed-star catalogue with complete Arabic and English descriptions
description:
Work-level record for al-Battānī's fixed-star catalogue from the Opus Astronomicum / Kitāb al-Zīj. The current reader and dataset contain 485 numbered star rows across 47 Ptolemaic figures, with authoritative ecliptic longitude and latitude values, north/south signs, magnitudes, modern Bayer/Flamsteed/common-name identifications, and Arabic/English star descriptions for every row. The documented Escorial-codex lacuna for Argo Navis, Hydra, and the beginning of Crater is shown explicitly.

The catalogue coordinate layer and Arabic/English description layer are complete at the current working-edition level. The descriptions remain audit-facing scholarly working text, not a claim of final philological commentary. The attached source ZIP includes TeX, CSV/TSV data, build scripts, and working notes; the Nallino source witness is included for auditability.

This record is a focused citable extract from the broader non-European mathematics manuscript corpus, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20410957, and the main raw/provenance backstop, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488.
notes: Complete working fixed-star catalogue: 485 numbered star rows with longitude, latitude, N/S sign, magnitude, modern identifications, and Arabic/English descriptions for every row. The documented source lacuna is shown explicitly rather than silently filled.
